functions.name: edge_material
functions.description: Signing secret + live device-token digests + session-lifetime knobs, for the httpsfront edge to enforce auth offline. device_used reports the device tokens the edge accepted since its last fetch; token_scopes names the scopes the edge enforces, and a scoped token goes only to an edge that names its scope.

functions.name: status
functions.description: Report the session lifetime and the number of live device tokens.

functions.name: device_mint
functions.description: Mint a revocable operator device token, for an unattended device or app that must not store a password. The token is returned once. Operator only. scope narrows the token to a few exact request shapes: avatar-stage admits only the avatar stage session (the WebSocket /hub/session/avatar/stage).

functions.name: device_list
functions.description: List device tokens (no secrets). Operator only.

functions.name: device_revoke
functions.description: Revoke a device token by id. The edge stops honouring it within its ~30 s material refresh. Operator only.

session_ttl_hours.description: Sliding session lifetime: a browser cookie is refreshed to this many hours ahead on each authenticated request.
session_ttl_hours.title: Session Ttl Hours

max_session_days.description: Hard ceiling on total session age; sliding refresh stops past this and re-login is required.
